chronology: Read complete rubric, schema and both supplied prompt files.
Read every complete source module with numbered lines.
Authored and ran extract.py, saving all source signatures and binding inventories before opening cases.json.
Read all 12 cases; compared independently saved source signatures against expected predicates.
Authored assemble_review.py to preserve judgments, verify case/source identities, format the strict review and record methodology.
Validated review schema and evidence bounds with preserved stdlib validation helper.
tools: exec_command shell: pwd, rg --files restricted to the packet, cat, wc -l, nl -ba, mkdir
whole_module_inspection: Read all 261, 571 and 253 source lines respectively; examined every module statement and class body, import binding, definition, assignment target and enclosing expression. Deferred function/method bodies were read but not treated as evaluated module-binding scopes. AST inventory supplements this reading; it is not a general-purpose Python scope engine.
signature_extraction: extract.py derives ordered parameters from posonlyargs/args/defaults/vararg/kwonlyargs/kw_defaults/kwarg, dumping annotation/default/return/decorator expressions and async status directly from AST before reading predicates. Missing expressions are JSON null. During assembly only the independently chosen return_annotation_ast field name is renamed to the packet expected-signature vocabulary returns_ast.

hash_verification.cases: Computed raw cases.json SHA256 and checked 12 distinct IDs and exact source coverage.
hash_verification.packet_hash_basis: Coordinator-supplied packet identity; packet digest framing algorithm was not supplied. No claim of independently recomputing that aggregate digest.

access_limitations: Only this public packet and this newly created output directory were read for task evidence.
No network, Git, other packets/reviewers, private maps/keys, policy outputs, CAMI/generator/reference code, project imports or source execution were used.
Review assesses bounded syntax; runtime decorator effects, import resolution, behavior and actual binding execution are outside scope.
Source path identities are those mapped by cases.json; no repository source outside the packet was consulted.
independence_disclosure: Model weights and training independence are unverified.
